prompt: Create a clean photorealistic three-view modeling reference sheet for one compact Korean domestic water booster pump, based strictly on the attached real product photograph. Show the SAME pump in side, opposite three-quarter, and top views, separated on a pale neutral background. Preserve its horizontal cylindrical teal-green electric motor with lengthwise cooling fins and black rear fan cover, low flat black electrical box mounted above it, black circular cast-iron front pump casing, two opposed horizontal pipe unions coming from the sides of that casing, four mounting feet and a short black cable connecting the top box to the motor. The motor axis runs horizontally. Use realistic compact proportions: approximately 27.5 cm long, 27 cm across pipe unions, 20.7 cm tall; inlet/outlet are about 1.25 inch. Remove brand names and all text but keep the manufactured housing shapes. No giant tank, no extra valves, no floating parts, no rust, no dramatic lighting, no decorative panels. This is a derivative unbranded game-prop reference, with crisp matte painted iron, fine metal fins, subtle plastic, soft studio lighting. Do not invent a different pump in each view.

references.use: 제품의 모터 방열판, 전장함, 케이싱, 포트 위치 참조. 원본 사진은 배포하지 않는다.
제조사 PB 계열 설명서. 게임의 세척 회로 용량을 계산한 설계가 아니라 소품의 구조와 비율 참조다.
